# Svalbard Special Zone Polygon

A WGS84 polygon in Svalbard whose longitude falls in the special UTM 33X band handling range. Used to show the difference between naive UTM zone assignment and the Svalbard exception rules.

|---|---|
| Case ID | `svalbard_special_zone_polygon` |
| Category | vector |
| Format | GeoJSON |
| Geometry type | Polygon |
| CRS | `EPSG:4326` |

| Status | validated |

## What this case checks

Confirm that robust UTM-zone logic applies the Svalbard special zone rules.
